Video.summary: Have you ever thought about how your relationship with your dad affects your life? A daughter who has a positive relationship with her father often has a better chance of thriving in life. But for girls who realize they're not Daddy's little girl, the damage to their life can be devastating. Lauren says her dad has not been there for her emotionally and financially, and she blames him for everything that has gone wrong in her life. They fight often, and she says she wants to let go of him and move on, but her father, Gary, wants her back in his life. Lauren has a college degree but is working in a scandalous profession. Is her job choice related to her relationship with her father? When father and daughter reveal important information they've each been hiding, how will they react to each other’s revelations? What do Lauren and Gary need to do to move forward with their lives, and will it include having a relationship with each other? Then, Angela and her daughter, Lily, are both experiencing the aftermath of not having a relationship with their fathers. Angela says she's had problems with men her entire life and worries Lily will also. Lily says her father is not there for her, and she has given up hope that they can revive their relationship. Are Angela's actions causing a rift between Lily and her father? Dr. Phil has a stern warning for the teen.
Video.title: Not Daddy's Little Girl

Video.summary: A 13-year-old's powerful and disturbing diary entries have Dr. Phil very concerned. Trisha says her daughter's pain stems from her father's discipline. How do you know if your discipline crosses the line into abuse?
Video.title: Extreme Discipline?

Video.summary: Being a single mother is hard enough, but imagine juggling soccer practice, PTA meetings and homework ... all while trying to cover up a secret life. Susan is a single mom with two kids who works as a prostitute to pay the bills. She says she's never had a real job and is addicted to the money she makes as an escort. Can Susan ditch her dangerous job and turn her life around? Then, Stephanie is a single mother of four and has been hiding a secret for 12 years. She's addicted to painkillers and takes up to 60 times the recommended dosage just to make it through the day. Fearing for their lives and those of their children, the women turn to Dr. Phil.
Video.title: Secret Lives of Single Moms

Video.summary: Tiffany, 23, shocked her parents when she admitted that she was hooked on heroin. After successfully completing a treatment program, and 166 days into her recovery, she relapsed. Find out who she blames for her addiction problems!
Video.title: Daddy's Little Girl

Video.summary: Parent alert: If you have a teenager, watch this show with him or her. Dr. Phil takes a close look at the harsh reality of young girls and boys having a baby while they're still just a baby themselves. It doesn't just happen to the bad girl down the street; your child can become pregnant while living under your roof.
Video.title: Teen Pregnancy

Video.summary: Tiffany and Mindy describe their mother, Phyllis, as “the most selfish person on the face of the earth.” They say their entire childhoods were affected by her self-absorbed behavior, ultimately fracturing their relationship. Tiffany says she worries she won’t even be able to come up with anything nice to say about her mother at her funeral. Phyllis insists she was a great mother, and her daughters have it all wrong. Dr. Phil goes over some of the incidents her daughters report as manipulative and self-centered. Will Phyllis own up to her parenting mistakes and apologize? And, Chanell says her friend, Shauna, suffers from “Pretty Girl Selfish Syndrome” and needs an intervention. Shauna says she’s open to a minor tweak in her behavior, but a major overhaul is out of the question. And, see the remarkable progress of two women who Dr. Phil says should be selfish and put themselves first: Amanda and Bekki from the 17 Day Diet Challenge. Plus, Dr. Phil celebrates his 1500th show with his oldest and youngest fans!
Video.title: Me,Me,Me: Selfish People

Video.summary: Christina, 21, and her younger sister, Carlie, 13, say they had a close relationship with their father, Michael, until two years ago when he decided to transition to a female. Michael was a police officer, soldier and loving parent who lived his life as a male for 40 years. Now, he wants his daughters to call him Mom, because he says Dad is gone, but they refuse. Michael, who prefers to be called Kayla, says she wants to explain to her daughters why she's living as a woman, but they've never given her the chance. The last time Christina saw her father was two years ago when he showed up at her work in lace and blue jeans to break the news that he's transgendered. When she sees Kayla onstage, does she greet her with open arms? Next, Carlie joins her sister and father. She says she wants her old dad back, but will she feel the same after seeing Kayla? Can the father-daughter bond be turned into a mother-daughter one? Be prepared for an emotional journey as two daughters struggle to understand how someone they loved so much could hurt them so badly.
Video.title: Daddy Drama

Video.summary: Tara had big dreams when she married Steve. Now, she feels like she's signed on to a life of misery and a mother-in-law who butts into their business.
Video.title: My Meddling Mother-in-Law

Video.summary: In part 2, Dr. Phil finally meets 28-year-old Cassie, who admits to being a drug addict since high school and using drugs with her father, Dave, in the past. Cassie ran out of the studio one hour before taping, with staffers chasing her, to buy alcohol. So, is Cassie really ready to be sober?
Video.title: Will Cassie Keep Running Part 2

Video.summary: In September 2010, 24-year-old Michelle O’Connell was found shot to death in what authorities ruled a suicide -- a case that was recently ordered reopened by the governor of Florida. Michelle’s mother, Patricia, and sister, Jennifer, insist the young mother never would have taken her own life, and they believe Michelle’s boyfriend, Jeremy -- a sheriff’s deputy -- killed her, which he denies. Michelle’s brother, Scott -- also a sheriff’s deputy -- supports Jeremy and says his mother and sister need to stop living in denial. How does he answer his mother’s accusation that he’s betraying his family to save his job? Dr. Phil brings this fractured family together in search of answers. What happened to Michelle that night? Hear from one of the first responders on the scene -- why does she believe the initial finding of suicide was wrong? Plus, can this family put their differences aside and come together and grieve for Michelle?
Video.title: The Death of Michelle O'Connell

Video.summary: Sixteen-year-old Amanda has been missing for five months. Her parents believe she ran away with her boyfriend and what they call his "gypsy family." Dr. Phil puts his own investigator on the case to go in search of the runaway teen.
Video.title: The Hunt For Amanda

Video.summary: Tracy is a successful, working actress who has appeared on many daytime soap operas including The Bold and The Beautiful and The Young and The Restless. She wrote into the show urgently seeking Dr. Phil’s help for her real-life drama of her hoarding 71-year-old-mother, Robin, who could be evicted from her home at any minute. Tracy claims her mother’s homes have always been filled with filth, chaos, and animals, and she’s never taken responsibility for the conditions Tracy lived in growing up. Tracy says she feels like the child of a drug addict, except the drug is hoarding, and she’s looking for Dr. Phil’s help to truly change her mom’s behavior before she’s back in another house of filth again. Robin says she knows she needs help with her hoarding, but the idea of getting rid of her possessions gives her anxiety. She says she’s ready to fix herself with the help of Dr. Phil, and this show is an answer to her prayers.
Video.title: Actress Confronts Hoarder Mother

Video.summary: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!
Video.title: My Dad Was The Breast Pump Bandit (Part 1)

Video.summary: Think you’re ready to say, “I do?”… not so fast! Dr. Phil puts 3 newly engaged couples to the test in his Premarital Boot Camp series, with real-life challenges like parenting, fighting, money, and sex. Find out what happens when one couple leaves their “baby” unattended six times and why another couple has to do some major explaining to the California Highway Patrol. Will they all make it to the altar… and who will win big prizes?
Video.title: Premarital Bootcamp (Pt.1)

Video.summary: It's one last test for three engaged couples before they start their lives as husband and wife - or not. See how they do in Dr. Phil's hilarious "Pre-Newlywed Game!"
Video.title: Premarital Bootcamp (Pt.3)

Video.summary: How has the role of the man evolved in the modern family? One woman claims her husband provides her with everything—except love and affection. He says he only knows how to provide financially. Can Dr. Phil help them find a balance and save their marriage of 17 years? Then, one guest entered into a new relationship after leaving his wife and kids. Now, his guilt is causing him to lie, manipulate and become physically abusive. Find out what Dr. Phil has to say to these men about the true measure of a man’s success in a relationship!
Video.title: Role of the Man

Video.summary: Dr. Phil looks into the nature of passive aggressive and pessimistic behaviors. One wife needs Dr. Phil’s help dealing with her passive aggressive husband. He never tells her what he’s thinking and often leaves to avoid confrontation. She says this punishment is hurtful and has their marriage in serious jeopardy. Plus, meet a college student whose negativity is alienating her from friends and potential boyfriends. Tune in for Dr. Phil’s cure for this bad case of bad attitude.
Video.title: Naysayers and Passive Aggressives

Video.summary: Is compulsive spending ruining your life? According to a recent Gallup poll, the average American owes $29,000 in credit card debt, and last year, 1.6 million U.S. households filed for bankruptcy. Dr. Phil has advice for avoiding credit card catastrophes this holiday season.
Video.title: Where'd The Money Go?

Video.summary: Dr. Phil tackles his guests' parenting questions. Ken is tired of being torn between his new wife and his daughter. How can this blended family get along? Then, 7-year-old Kailin is a terror to her family. Her parents have tried spanking, timeouts, and every other trick in the book... but could they be part of the problem? Plus, Dr. Phil has advice on dating after divorce when your kids are watching your every move.
Video.title: Ask Dr Phil

Video.summary: Top-of-the-line cars, boats and designer labels! Do you know someone whose spending is out of control? Dr. Phil speaks with guests who are fed up with the high roller in their life.
Video.title: My Big Fat Spoiled Family Member

Video.summary: Is there someone in your life you just can’t stand? Wouldn’t life be easier if you could find a way to make peace? Dr. Phil speaks with people who often struggle to get along: the ex-wife and the stepmom. Jennifer and her ex-husband’s new wife, Carol, hated each other for two years, until one pivotal moment changed their relationship forever. Together, they wrote the book No One’s the Bitch, and offer the 10 steps to strengthening the stepfamily -- starting with the women. Then, Lori says she's had a tense and rocky relationship with her husband’s ex-wife, Stephanie, and says the past eight years have been difficult. Can Dr. Phil get these two women to negotiate a new relationship? Just what are the boundaries for a stepmother? There are 1,300 stepfamilies forming every day in the U.S. Learn what you can do to ensure a happy and healthy family.
Video.title: How To Get Along With Anyone

Video.summary: It was the picture-perfect wedding: a model marrying the handsome man she says treated her like gold. But after a few years of marriage, Kevin and Heather are in a dangerous relationship filled with verbal abuse and violence. Should these two work on saving their marriage or get out before someone gets killed?
Video.title: A Model's Dangerous Marriage

Video.summary: They borrow money and don't pay you back. They're unemployed and never pay rent. If you're tired of a loved one's freeloading ways, Dr. Phil has advice for getting the handouts to stop. Ryan, 29, says he's living the life of "a starving artist," but his sisters say he's just a moocher. He even tries to mooch off Dr. Phil! Then, Jennell says her husband has turned her into a moocher by forcing her to ask her own mother to pay their bills. Will he give up his dreams of playing poker professionally or keep gambling by living off their savings and watching his marriage slip away?
Video.title: Ultimate Moocher

Video.summary: A Dr. Phil exclusive. A beautiful teen goes missing on spring break. Now, 7 years later, shocking new allegations – was Brittanee kidnapped, killed, and thrown into a gator pit? Her family gives their first interview since hearing the nightmarish details about what a jailhouse informant claims happened to their daughter. Plus, hear what a surprising guest has to say – do they know something about Brittanee’s murder?
Video.title: Missing At Spring Break

Video.summary: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!
Video.title: Cancel Culture Pt 2

Video.summary: Robin joins Dr. Phil to answer your questions ... including the ones asking her to give up the dirt on Dr. Phil! What's Dr. Phil really like at home? What lands him in the doghouse? How does Robin stay in shape?
Video.title: Ask Dr Phil and Robin

Video.summary: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Christina, who emailed him desperate for help for her daughter, Tara, who she says can be an angry monster. Christina left the home when Tara was 13 years old, but now, she says she's worried that her daughter is in a toxic situation with the ex-husband she calls narcissistic and his 22-year-old new wife who is 20 weeks pregnant. Today, meet the new wife and find out if Dr. Phil can help this chaotic triangle.
Video.title: Family Triangle Drama (Part 2)

Video.summary: Dr. Phil meets guests who say their perfect day was ruined by everything from booze, to broken down limousines, to grooms from hell, and now their marriages suffer because they can't stop reliving their wedding gone bad.
Video.title: Weddings Gone Bad

Video.summary: This is one powerful episode you can’t miss! Join us as Dr. Phil gives out-of-control mothers the tools they need to curb their offensive behavior. Learn how one single mother’s yelling and offensive language are driving away her teenage kids. Plus, one woman gave up a career to be a stay-at-home mom. Now regret and anxiety have taken over to create a potentially dangerous situation for her children. Whether dealing with teenagers or toddlers, every parent knows that unrelated stress can lead to unwanted outbursts. Learn through these courageous moms how you can be a better parent.
Video.title: Can't Stand Being a Mom

Video.summary: Heather and Chris say their six-year marriage is on the brink of divorce because of their constant heated arguments, which they admit happen almost daily, in front of their two young children. Heather, a stay-at-home mom, says Chris is so controlling that he constantly accuses her of cheating on him, checks her phone records to see whom she’s calling and won’t let her handle their finances. Chris says Heather is only with him for the money and has gotten violent with him during their disagreements -- some of which have been caught on tape. He says she has kicked him in the privates, slapped him in the face and thrown a tape measure at his head -- all in front of the kids. What’s driving the couple’s anger? Plus, Chris recently filed for divorce -- will he change his mind and agree to work on their marriage? Then, Kerry says she and her husband, Sam, engage in explosive fighting at least four times a week, and she fears someone will get seriously hurt. Can this couple learn to fight fairly? This program contains strong language. Viewer discretion advised.
Video.title: Threats, Fights And Videotape

Video.summary: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil once again exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge of committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live with the fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Joanna says her rage is scaring her son. Michelle’s rage has driven her to slap her child and hit her with a wooden spoon. Lisa admits to pulling her daughter’s hair when she gets angry. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.
Video.title: Moms on the Verge Part 2

Video.summary: Send the kids out of the room because Dr. Phil is talking about sex! Was the passion off the charts when you first started dating your spouse, but now your bedroom is a dead zone? If so, it’s time to resuscitate your relationship! With the help of Rabbi Shmuley Boteach, host of TLC’s Shalom in the Home and author of the book, The Kosher Sutra: Eight Sacred Secrets for Reigniting Desire and Restoring Passion for Life, Dr. Phil speaks with couples who say they’ve lost their libidos and want to bring back the magic. First up are Joy and Mark who say they haven’t had sex in almost four years. In fact, Joy says the last great sex she had was in 1988! Find out why Mark is terrified to make love to his wife. And, Kim and Adam have been married only four months and say they fight more than they have sex. How can they enjoy the honeymoon phase if they go to bed mad at each other? Plus, don’t miss the top five reasons you should have sex!
Video.title: More Sex, Less Fighting
